- The app is served over plain HTTP (no SSL, no HTTPS redirects) and accepts any host name.
- `GET /up` responds with `200` when the app is ready.
- The app keeps all its data under `storage/`. It must not call external services.

Our QA auto-tests drive the app in a browser and rely on the labels in quotes in each task. Keep them exactly as written, as visible text, a <label>, a placeholder, or an aria-label.

The QA auto-tests also expect:

- Each item of a list (a quiz, a question) sits in its own list item or table row, with its buttons and links inside it.
- Switches are checkboxes (a styled switch is fine if a real checkbox sits under it).
- Confirmations use the browser's native `confirm()` dialog.

The game works, and now we want prizes.

The quiz settings get a new field, "Number of winners" (a number, at least 1, 3 by default).

Scoring:

- Each correct answer gives one point.
- Players with equal points are ranked by speed: the total time of their correct answers wins when it is lower. The time of an answer runs from the moment the question opens to the player's last pick.
- Players don't see points during the game.

Speed now decides ties, so all players must get each question at the same moment: the big screen and the phones must follow the moderator close to instantly.

After "End quiz":

- The big screen shows the leaderboard: one list item for each player, in order, with the place, the name, and the points ("2 points", "1 point", "0 points").
- Each player's phone shows the place ("Place 2 of 5") and the points ("3 points").

Picking the winners (N is the number of winners):

- The "Top N" button (for example, "Top 3") makes the first N players of the leaderboard the winners.
- The "Draw" button is for ties. Every player with more points than the N-th place wins. The remaining prizes are drawn at random among the players with exactly the N-th place's points (speed doesn't matter here). Each click draws again.
- Players with 0 points never win. If fewer than N players have points, all of them win.
- The "Reset winners" button removes the winners.
- Winners get the "Winner" mark on the leaderboard, and their phones show "You won!". Both update live.

## Data Model (Release 1: Moderator Prep)
- `Quiz` (`title`) has_many `Question` ordered by `position, id`.
- `Question` (`quiz_id`, `body`, `position`, `active`) has_many `Option` ordered by `position, id`.
- `Option` (`question_id`, `body`, `correct`, `position`).

## Design & Assets
- Design tokens, layout, and component classes live in `app/assets/stylesheets/quizzy.css` (adapted from `docs/mockups/quizzy.css`) with `app/assets/fonts/Inter-latin.woff2`.
- Lists (`quiz-list`, `question-list`) use semantic `<ul>` / `<li>` items so each item's controls sit inside its `<li>`.
- Confirmation dialogs use `data-turbo-confirm` (native `window.confirm()`).

## Moderator Area & Auth
- Everything under `/moderate` inherits from `Moderate::BaseController` and enforces HTTP Basic Authentication against `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME` and `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD` using SHA-256 + `ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare`.
- Preview (`/moderate/quizzes/:id/preview`) is client-side via Stimulus (`preview_controller.js`) over active questions only; no preview answers are persisted.

## Quiz Export & Import
- Export (`GET /moderate/quizzes/:id/export`) serializes `Quiz#export_payload` with `JSON.pretty_generate` inside a single `<pre>` element, writing only `title`, `questions` (`text`, `active`, `options`), and `options` (`text`, `correct`) in preserved order.
- Import (`GET /moderate/quizzes/import`, `POST /moderate/quizzes/import`) is handled by `QuizImport` (`ActiveModel::Model`), validating structure and question/option rules atomically inside a transaction so invalid payloads import nothing. `active` defaults to `true` and `correct` defaults to `false` when omitted.

## Live Game (Release 2)
- `Game` (`quiz_id`, `code`, `quiz_title`, `status`, `current_question_index`, `started_at`, `finished_at`) snapshots active questions and options into `GameQuestion` and `GameOption` via `Game.create_from_quiz`, skipping inactive questions and isolating running/past games from later quiz edits.
- `Player` (`game_id`, `name`, `token`) is remembered per game via a signed HTTP-only cookie (`quizzy_player_<code>`).
- `Answer` has a unique index on `[player_id, game_question_id]` so changing an answer updates the single row (`last pick counts`).
- Moderator big screen lives at `/moderate/games/:id` (`Moderate::GamesController`, layout `screen`) and uses `rqrcode` (`RQRCode::QRCode`) to render the join link QR code as an inline `<svg>`.
- Player flow lives at `/play/:code` (`PlayController`) and never renders `correct` / `is-correct` in HTML or ActionCable payloads while a question is open.
- Live updates use `GameChannel` (authorized via signed `ActiveSupport::MessageVerifier` tokens) and `GameBroadcaster` (`async` adapter in `config/cable.yml`), paired with `live_screen_controller.js` / `live_play_controller.js` that sync state on WebSocket connect/reconnect/`visibilitychange`/`online` and fall back to `/state` JSON polling if WebSocket is disconnected on flaky conference Wi-Fi.

  CODE_ALPHABET = "ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789".chars.freeze
  CODE_LENGTH = 5

  LeaderboardEntry = Struct.new(:player, :place, :points, :total_time, keyword_init: true) do

  has_many :game_questions, -> { order(:position, :id) }, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :players, -> { order(:created_at, :id) }, dependent: :destroy

  enum :status, {
    lobby: "lobby",
    question_open: "question_open",
    question_closed: "question_closed",
    finished: "finished"
  }, validate: true

  validates :code, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :quiz_title, presence: true
  validates :winners_count, numericality: { only_integer: true, greater_than_or_equal_to: 1 }
  validates :current_question_index, numericality: { only_integer: true, greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }

  def self.stream_verifier
    Rails.application.message_verifier(:game_stream)

  def self.create_from_quiz(quiz)
    active = quiz.active_questions.includes(:options).to_a
    game = new(
      quiz: quiz,
      quiz_title: quiz.title,
      winners_count: quiz.winners_count,
      status: :lobby,
      current_question_index: 0
    )

    if active.empty?
      game.errors.add(:base, "Add at least one active question before starting a game")
      return game
    end

    transaction do
      game.code = generate_unique_code
      game.save!

      active.each_with_index do |q, q_idx|
        gq = game.game_questions.create!(
          question: q,
          position: q_idx + 1,
          body: q.body
        )
        q.options.each_with_index do |opt, o_idx|
          gq.game_options.create!(
            option: opt,
            position: o_idx + 1,
            body: opt.body,
            correct: opt.correct?
          )
        end
      end
    end

    game
  end

  def self.generate_unique_code
    loop do
      candidate = Array.new(CODE_LENGTH) { CODE_ALPHABET.sample }.join
      return candidate unless exists?(code: candidate)
    end
  end

  def current_question
    game_questions.includes(:game_options).find_by(position: current_question_index + 1)
  end

  def current_question_number
    current_question_index + 1
  end

  def total_questions
    game_questions.count
  end

  def last_question?
    current_question_index >= total_questions - 1
  end

  def players_count
    players.count
  end

  def current_answers_count
    q = game_questions.find_by(position: current_question_index + 1)
    q ? q.answers.count : 0
  end

  def state_version_for_moderator
    if finished?
      winner_ids = players.where(winner: true).order(:id).pluck(:id).join(",")
      "finished:#{winners_revision}:#{winner_ids}"
    else
      "#{status}:#{current_question_index}:#{players_count}:#{current_answers_count}"
    end
  end

  def state_version_for_player(player)
    return "guest:#{status}" if player.nil?
    return "finished:#{winners_revision}:#{player.winner? ? 'w' : 'l'}" if finished?
    return "lobby" if lobby?

    q = game_questions.find_by(position: current_question_index + 1)
    picked_id = q&.answers&.find_by(player_id: player.id)&.game_option_id
    "#{status}:#{current_question_index}:#{picked_id || 'none'}"
  end

  def start!
    with_lock do
      return false unless lobby?
      return false if game_questions.empty?

      now = Time.current
      update!(
        status: :question_open,
        current_question_index: 0,
        started_at: now
      )
      game_questions.find_by!(position: 1).update!(opened_at: now)
      true
    end
  end

  def finish_question!
    with_lock do
      return false unless question_open?

      update!(status: :question_closed)
      true
    end
  end

  def next_question!
    with_lock do
      return false unless question_closed?

      if last_question?
        update!(status: :finished, finished_at: Time.current)
      else
        next_index = current_question_index + 1
        now = Time.current
        update!(
          status: :question_open,
          current_question_index: next_index
        )
        game_questions.find_by!(position: next_index + 1).update!(opened_at: now)
      end
      true
    end
  end

  def join_player(name:)
    with_lock do
      return nil if finished?

      player = players.build(name: name)
      player.save
      player
    end
  end

  def submit_answer!(player:, game_option_id:)
    with_lock do
      return false unless question_open?

      question = current_question
      return false unless question

      option = question.game_options.find_by(id: game_option_id)
      return false unless option

      answer = Answer.find_or_initialize_by(player: player, game_question: question)
      answer.game_option = option
      answer.answered_at = Time.current
      answer.save!
      true
    end
  end

  def leaderboard
    all_players = players.order(:created_at, :id).to_a
    return [] if all_players.empty?

    questions_by_id = game_questions.index_by(&:id)
    correct_option_ids = GameOption.where(game_question_id: questions_by_id.keys, correct: true).pluck(:id).to_set

    stats = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = { points: 0, total_time: 0.0 } }

    Answer.where(game_question_id: questions_by_id.keys).find_each do |ans|
      next unless correct_option_ids.include?(ans.game_option_id)

      gq = questions_by_id[ans.game_question_id]
      opened = gq&.opened_at || gq&.created_at || started_at || ans.created_at
      picked = ans.answered_at || ans.updated_at || ans.created_at
      elapsed = [ (picked - opened).to_f, 0.0 ].max

      entry = stats[ans.player_id]
      entry[:points] += 1
      entry[:total_time] += elapsed
    end

    sorted = all_players.sort_by do |p|
      s = stats[p.id]
      [ -s[:points], s[:total_time], p.created_at, p.id ]
    end

    sorted.each_with_index.map do |p, idx|
      s = stats[p.id]
      LeaderboardEntry.new(
        player: p,
        place: idx + 1,
        points: s[:points],
        total_time: s[:total_time]
      )
    end
  end

  def leaderboard_entry_for(player)
    return nil unless player

    leaderboard.find { |e| e.player_id == player.id }
  end

  def pick_top_winners!
    with_lock do
      return false unless finished?

      winner_ids = leaderboard.select { |e| e.points > 0 }.first(winners_count).map(&:player_id)
      apply_winners!(winner_ids)
      true
    end
  end

  def draw_winners!
    with_lock do
      return false unless finished?

      eligible = leaderboard.select { |e| e.points > 0 }
      winner_ids = if eligible.size <= winners_count
                     eligible.map(&:player_id)
                   else
                     cutoff_points = eligible[winners_count - 1].points
                     guaranteed = eligible.select { |e| e.points > cutoff_points }
                     remaining_slots = winners_count - guaranteed.size
                     tied = eligible.select { |e| e.points == cutoff_points }
                     drawn = tied.sample(remaining_slots)
                     (guaranteed + drawn).map(&:player_id)
                   end

      apply_winners!(winner_ids)
      true
    end
  end

  def reset_winners!
    with_lock do
      return false unless finished?

      apply_winners!([])
      true
    end
  end

  def signed_moderator_stream_token
    self.class.stream_verifier.generate({ "role" => "moderator", "game_id" => id })
  end

  def signed_player_stream_token(player)
    self.class.stream_verifier.generate({ "role" => "player", "game_id" => id, "player_id" => player.id })
  end

  def signed_guest_stream_token
    self.class.stream_verifier.generate({ "role" => "guest", "game_id" => id })
  end

  private

  def apply_winners!(winner_ids)
    players.update_all(winner: false)
    players.where(id: winner_ids).update_all(winner: true) if winner_ids.any?
    players.reset
    increment!(:winners_revision)
  end
end

      return
    end

      end
      format.html { redirect_to play_path(@game.code), status: :see_other }
    end
  end

    server_version = @game.state_version_for_player(@player)
    if params[:state_version].to_s == server_version || (@player.nil? && !@game.finished?)
      render json: { changed: false }
      return
    end

    assign_stage_variables
    html = render_to_string(
      partial: "play/stage",
      locals: {
        game: @game,
        player: @player,
        question: @question,
        picked_option_id: @picked_option_id,
        player_entry: @player_entry,

  end
end

    travel_to(t1 + 2.seconds) { game.submit_answer!(player: bob, game_option_id: gq2_right.id) }

    # Q2: Dave picks wrong (0 pts)

    game.next_question!
